ordinary_task_script_semantics: Read the original frozen per-job JSON input through its authorized task workspace.

Write a UTF-8 JSON report with exactly schema_version=1, job_index, seed, rounds=500000, result=x; close/fsync before command exit.

oracle_design.independent_math: Exponentiate the three-by-three matrix [[a,1,b],[0,1,1],[0,0,1]] modulo2^32 to power500000 and apply to column [seed,0,1]. This derives the final answer without executing or importing the task loop.
oracle_design.artifact: Read actual version-bound JSON report and historical notes link through existing independent artifact/authority oracles. Require exact original job/seed/rounds/result and original input SHA.
controls_before_driver: rounds0 identity, rounds1 direct arithmetic, two-step seed0 result1196435763 and seed1 result1586005468
a=1,b=0 closed form seed+n(n-1)/2 for multiple n
a=0 final value b+n-1 when n>0
wrong seed/rounds/result, extra field, noninteger numeric value, missing/truncated report, wrong historical link and source SHA rejected

oracle_design.source_identity: Obtain input SHA independently from original accepted invocation/fixed input_ref and actual input bytes. The exact five-field report has no self-asserted source SHA and may not add one to manufacture authority.

measurement.latencies: Every original accepted timestamp through independently confirmed completion; report p50/p95/p99, queue and actual execution separately.
measurement.failures: All12 batches and all768 attempts retained. Any invalid/missing output or resource observation prevents full X04 pass. No selection of fastest successes.
measurement.batch_denominator: One monotonic clock: start immediately before the first of64 Runtime acceptance calls; finish after all64 independent artifacts are valid and all original holders are physically stopped/published/confirmed/released. Includes acceptance, queue, execution and release. throughput=64/(finish-start). Every batch uses the same boundaries; any failed or missing job fails the batch.
measurement.setup_boundary: Ordinary input fixture provisioning and fixed shared-service startup occur before the measured start uniformly for all12 batches. No task/Session/tool execution or per-job active environment may start before it. Record setup and execution times separately; no dynamic prewarming or selected exclusion.
measurement.percentile: Nearest-rank percentiles on all64 original job durations, rank=ceil(p*64), one-based. Preserve raw per-job timestamps and queue/dispatch/completion evidence; do not replace failed samples with successful retry latencies.

resources: Exactly original shared system slot/global CPU/memory/object/bytes/inode budgets; no new quota.
